title: Book 1, Aphorisms 92–115
author: Francis Bacon
source: *Novum Organum*, Book 1, Aphorisms 92–115, in the English translation edited by Joseph Devey (New York: P. F. Collier & Son, 1902), 73–90. Bacon published the *Novum Organum* in Latin in 1620.
summary: Against the despair that most hinders the sciences, Bacon sets out the grounds for hope: the errors of the past themselves, a new and better ordered experience, written records of experiment, a ladder of axioms rising by degrees, and a true induction; if chance has given us gunpowder, silk and the compass, method should give far more.
